capabilities: Open sefaria.org links and obsidian://sefaria references in a sidebar reader
Search the library by reference, title or full text
Browse categories down to a book, chapter, daf or siman
Switch Hebrew/English layouts, fonts, text size, vowels and cantillation
Copy segments as Hebrew, English, reference or Markdown link
extras: Not reviewed by Obsidian team per the manifest. Requires an internet connection to Sefaria's public API (no account or API key); nothing is written to the vault. Requires Obsidian 1.13+; older versions get 0.3.1. Roadmap lists commentaries, cross-references and version choice as future work.
problem: Reading Sefaria texts normally means leaving Obsidian for the browser, breaking the flow of writing notes alongside sources.

relations.evidence: This plugin is powered by Sefaria's open API but was not developed by Sefaria.

summary: Sidebar reader that displays Jewish texts from the Sefaria library in Hebrew and English, opened via links, references, search or a library browser.
